kind: workflow service with embedded AI-agent steps

runtime.execution: PostgreSQL queue and Rust workers launch language child processes; AI steps await provider/MCP requests and queued tool jobs.
runtime.service_boundary: Service owns worker scheduling, queue, job state, memory and administration; Arconaut would consume it rather than acquire its governance.

summary: Programmable job/flow service; embedded model tools are ordinary permissioned jobs, with separate execution history and compactable context.

inspection.scope: queue completion/cancellation/deploy restart, child lifecycle, Python wrapper, flow advancement, AI dispatch/memory/compaction, public API and direct test assertions
inspection.limits: Private enterprise implementations are absent; no service/process execution and no exhaustive language executor or UI review.

actions.name: POST /jobs/run/preview, /run/preview_flow, /run/agent/{path}
actions.input: script/flow/agent path or preview program plus args/workspace
actions.output: job UUID; separately query/list results and progress
actions.authority: caller workspace identity and effective job authority

actions.name: execute_tool_calls -> enqueue_windmill_tool
actions.input: advertised function name and JSON arguments; authored flow module
actions.output: child job UUID, ordered tool result, AgentAction identity
actions.lifecycle: batch concurrent jobs; poll completed table and optionally reserve one local worker
actions.authority: job or configured on-behalf-of identity with tag checks

actions.name: MCP tool dispatch
actions.input: registered MCP function and JSON arguments
actions.lifecycle: await remote MCP client; cleanup/abort after parent cancellation
actions.authority: configured external credentials and advertised tool roster

actions.name: WAC dispatch/suspend/resume
actions.input: named steps, checkpoints, pending sleep/approval and resume rows
actions.lifecycle: fresh process replays program against stored checkpoint; excludes already-consumed resume rows
actions.authority: authored workflow and authorized resume actor

actions.name: cancel job / timeout child
actions.input: job UUID and cancellation author/reason or time limit
actions.output: canceled result/reason and child exit; errors on termination
actions.lifecycle: poll DB; grace, direct-child signal escalation and reap; does not reverse remote effects

actions.name: compact_if_needed / Compactor.compact
actions.input: context history, provider, budget and trigger
actions.output: shorter model context or unchanged failure; original result unchanged
actions.lifecycle: additional provider request; storage truncation remains distinct
actions.authority: configured step policy; not arbitrary model powerword

actions.name: read_from_memory / write_to_memory
actions.lifecycle: DB UPSERT after run; public backend capped 100KB
actions.authority: worker DB authority scoped by key

actions.name: restart_perpetual_runs_on_new_version
actions.lifecycle: cancel and two-pass race recovery, not live execution continuation

filesystem.detail: Jobs run arbitrary authored language programs with per-job filesystem/result and monitored child lifecycle; not a shared standing kernel.

processes.detail: Jobs run arbitrary authored language programs with per-job filesystem/result and monitored child lifecycle; not a shared standing kernel.

code_actions.detail: Jobs run arbitrary authored language programs with per-job filesystem/result and monitored child lifecycle; not a shared standing kernel.

persistent_kernel.detail: Fresh wrapper/process plus WAC serialized checkpoints, not retained Python heap; public dedicated-loop worker support is not established.

standing_database.detail: Service owns PostgreSQL queue, completed results, flow status and scoped replaceable AI memory. A consuming harness does not govern the database.

workflow_programming.detail: Authored flow modules and WAC checkpoint/resume are actual programs; embedded AI tools dispatch nested jobs. Flow retry is not an external-effect transaction.

multi_model.detail: AI provider settings and nested AI-agent tool modules permit composed model roles; the inspected batching is jobs, not a live multi-model peer room.

live_collaboration.detail: Nested AI-agent jobs produce returned results; traced queue/agent paths do not establish addressable simultaneous chat peers.

concurrent_work.detail: Tool job batches execute independently, poll by UUID and publish ordered results; service has multiple workers.

steering_interrupt.detail: Cancel/timeouts propagate through DB polling/graceful agent cancellation and child signals; force abort does not undo external effects.

turn_redefinition.detail: User-authored flows/tools/WAC program control steps and outputs; AI step still uses a fixed worker loop rather than model-redefinable core turns.

compaction.detail: Threshold/context rejection/storage policies summarize selected prefix without changing run result; failed/non-shrinking summaries preserve context.

context_repair.detail: Original per-run result retained separately from context enables reconstruction by a consumer; no model-native context-repair operation traced.

original_audit.detail: Uncompacted run messages and job results exist, but saved memory can drop history, child logs have bounds, and community audit API is explicitly no-op/private.

audit_query.detail: Job/list/queue data and stored transcripts are queryable surfaces; enterprise audit query has no public implementation and returns empty/errors in OSS.

hot_change.detail: Deploy triggers perpetual-run cancellation/replacement, including race repair; not default turn-conclusion activation or in-process hot code swap.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Durable job/flow/WAC data and lost-cancel repair support service restart; no harness outpost/refit protocol and no preservation of arbitrary process heap.

remote_services.detail: Provider/MCP clients and HTTP job APIs are actual external boundaries. Shared Windmill service remains separately governed.

self_improvement.detail: Authored program deployment and preview execution supply change/experiment primitives, not a model-governed autoresearch evaluator.

complaints.detail: Stranded-job alerts/cancel reasons/logs capture service faults, not full agent-state complaint beads.

authority.detail: Effective identity/workspace/tag restrictions bound queued actions; service policies can be separate from a consuming operator-centric harness.

evaluation.detail: Inspected SQL tests specify eligible stranded jobs and race exclusion; compaction asserts original serialized results and tool exchange integrity, without judging semantic summary fidelity.

time_order.detail: Call-order transcript publication is separate from completion order; SQL cancellation and flow/checkpoint identity avoid stale/racing updates.

evidence.claim: Python wrappers persist result/errors; WAC checkpoint is loaded and prepared before a fresh Python process runs.
Child is monitored with timeout/cancellation, then structured result read; WAC dispatch is interpreted afterward, not resident Python variables.
Child wait competes with logs/timeout/cancel; Unix escalation signals direct child PID, then kills and reaps it. This alone is not an arbitrary descendant/service quiescence guarantee.
Queue row deletion and completed-result insertion are one SQL statement; external script effects precede database completion.
Flow advancement reloads durable module status and pinned runnable/preview flow after child completion.
AI tools are discovered by exposed name, MCP calls dispatched, adjacent ordinary modules batched, structured-output pseudo-tool terminates with arguments.
Queued tool UUIDs are polled from completed jobs; concurrent results become transcript/tool messages in original call order.
Tool job inherits effective job/on-behalf-of authority, workspace/tag restrictions, parent/root identities and priority.
AgentHistory maintains separate result and context; prefix replacement modifies only model context.
Compaction installs only a smaller usable summary, retains original history on failure/unhelpful output and bounds consecutive failures.
Standing memory key workspace/conversation/step; 100KB DB entry, optional oldest-message truncation, UPSERT replaces saved view.
Public OSS memory reads/writes PostgreSQL; enterprise object-storage implementation is separate/unavailable.
Community audit_log is a no-op, list_audit empty, get_audit rejects. Job transcripts are not this enterprise audit feature.
Deploy can restart perpetual scripts; second pass catches completion/restart race. This is cancellation/replacement rather than live kernel/code migration.
Stranded cancellation marks under SQL lock and repairs asynchronous completion lost on server stop; it excludes running jobs.
Agent cancellation gets grace period, then task abort handles and orphaned-job cleanup; MCP clients cleaned after outcome.
Returned run result uses unrewritten execution messages; saved memory may retain only newest complete exchanges or none.
WAC resume uses durable consumed resume-row IDs, inserts approval answer into completed_steps and saves checkpoint; identity separates approval steps.
Public HTTP run preview/flow/agent and queue/list APIs expose program invocation and job identities.
Direct tests compare complete serialized result before/after prefix change and assert parallel tool exchanges stay intact.

tests.oracle: Exact sorted eligible tag/count set; running job cancellation remains None; DB fixtures exercise real SQL state but not external process stop.
Exact serialized before/after result equality, distinct action IDs and exchange starts; synthetic summaries do not assess model fidelity.

strengths: Tool execution composes ordinary durable workflow jobs with useful UUIDs and ordered results.
Separate result/context arrays directly preserve in-run action history through compaction.
Public source makes community/enterprise audit and memory boundaries visible.
limits: Job DB completion is not atomic with arbitrary side effects.
100KB public memory and optional truncation require a separate original archive.
Unix direct-child signals alone do not settle arbitrary descendants or remote work.
arconaut_questions: Which job/result handles should Arconaut retain while Windmill remains an independent service?
Can compaction retain source originals and expose model repair without copying enterprise governance?
What observable acknowledgment settles each child/remote effect before refit?
